_about: Which table each feed writes to. The catalog and schema come from the named destination connection in connection_config.json, so feeds landing in the same place do not repeat it. Every feed key here must also exist in source_config.json.

defaults._load_type_note: What a run does to the table. 'full' deletes and loads, replacing the contents each run. 'append' adds rows, so history accumulates and re-running the same file duplicates it. 'delta' upserts on the primary key, which makes a re-run idempotent and needs source.primary_key set with uniqueness enforced. The behaviour behind each name is defined in runtime_config.load_types.
defaults._connection_note: 'connection' names an entry under connection_config.destinations, which supplies catalog and schema. A feed may still set catalog or schema directly to override just that part.
defaults._table_note: 'table' is the bare table name and is required per feed. Set append_filename_suffix true for one table per file, named <table>_<filename slug>.
defaults._schema_note: 'table_schema' null means derive it from the feed's source columns plus the selected metadata_columns, so there is no second copy of the schema to drift out of step.
defaults._metadata_note: metadata_columns selects by name from runtime_config.json's catalogue, which declares each column's type and the value it carries.

dataset1.description: Dataset1.csv -> Table01 in the bronze_dev destination.

file_daily.description: Every date-stamped drop accumulates in Table02 in the bronze_dev destination.
file_daily._load_note: Append is deliberate here: each daily drop is a new set of rows to keep, and _batch_id tells the drops apart. Note this makes a same-day re-run additive rather than idempotent - use 'delta' if a re-run should update in place instead, though AAA repeats across drops so it is not a usable key across the whole table.
